Cash Consideration: $26.45 per share; Parent Shares equal to the Exchange Ratio (1.0340) per Company share, with cash in lieu of fractional Parent Shares; Equity Award Exchange Ratio is the sum of (i) Cash Consideration divided by the Parent Share Price and (ii) the Exchange Ratio, used for equity awards; Other forms of merger consideration include Company Director RSU Award Consideration (cash for dividends) and Settled Stock Option Consideration (cash) and Cash Awards for PSU Awards, with Adjusted RSUs and Adjusted Stock Options as applicable; No CVRs are provided.
Fixed exchange ratio: 1.0340; each Company Common Stock share will be converted into the right to receive cash of 26.45 per share and a number of Parent Shares equal to the Exchange Ratio (1.0340), with cash in lieu of fractional Parent Shares per Section 2.1(c). Equity Award Exchange Ratio is defined as (Cash Consideration / Parent Share Price) + Exchange Ratio, rounded to four decimals.
